authorities.conclusion: The Met states public-domain artwork images and data are available without restriction under CC0; every selected object API response was individually checked for isPublicDomain=true before download.

Rogue, Skeleton and round-shield formal CC0 GLBs plus their textures are pinned by the approved bundle. Project-owned clean review renders preserve the input hashes, fixed camera and output hashes in character-render-manifest-v1.json.

Six distinct Arena V2 contract wireframes and one route-composition replacement are generated from the repository screen-map and Art Bible tokens. Their manifest pins authority, generator and output hashes; all remain source-review-only.
